Package persist.lint.legacy

package persist.lint.legacy
Legacy (javax) Persistence linter implementation.

This package provides NamedObjectParser and SchemaValidator implementations that target the javax.persistence namespace (JPA 2.x). It uses Hibernate 5 and its AST-based QueryTranslatorFactory to compile JPQL query strings and to validate entity schemas against a live database, verifying HQL grammar, entity mappings, and property paths entirely offline (except for schema validation).

  • LegacyPersistenceLinterFactory – abstract base providing the "javax" namespace.
  • LegacyNamedObjectParserFactory – registered as a ServiceLoader provider for NamedObjectParserFactory.
  • LegacySchemaValidatorFactory – registered as a ServiceLoader provider for SchemaValidatorFactory.
Since:
2.0.0
